summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox v1.1 milestone via the GSD manager, resolving Phase 42 unpin-integrity data-loss findings and broken IPNS subtree unenrollment across 5 parallel-executed plans.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed across 2 waves with worktree isolation, merged cleanly, and verified (3/3 must-haves passed). Code-review blockers fixed, /simplify extractions applied, Nyquist validation confirmed compliant, both security reviews found 0 exploitable issues, CodeRabbit CLI doc-consistency findings resolved, and legacy todos/done/ consolidated into todos/completed/. Branch is ready to ship.

repo: pnpm/orval resolves to workspace root rather than worktree root when run inside a git worktree — `pnpm api:generate` (132 api-client files) and SDK builds leak generated output into the main checkout's working tree, requiring detection and cleanup before merge

The husky `check-api-client.sh` + `pnpm lint-staged` pre-commit hook runs across ~131 generated api-client files on every commit touching openapi.json; this can stall or silently fail the GSD cleanup-wave helper's internal commit step, requiring manual merge completion

The GSD dep-parser misparses decimal milestone version strings (e.g. 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)') into phantom phase numbers like '1.1', marking dependencies as unsatisfied when they are actually complete

todos/done/ (70 items, frozen ~2026-06-15) is the legacy resolved-todos folder; todos/completed/ is canonical — all GSD tooling (close_phase_todos, check-todos, note, add-todo) reads/writes completed/ exclusively; the drift was never migrated
CodeRabbit and Greptile post their PR reviews with a lag after PR creation; CodeRabbit nitpicks land in the review BODY (not inline threads), so /resolve-pr-reviews must parse pulls/N/reviews[].body
The GSD commit helper false-negatives (reports commit_failed) even when commits succeed — always verify with git log

Leaving REVIEW.md at status: issues_found after fixing code-review findings in the same phase creates doc inconsistency that CodeRabbit CLI flags as critical; the fix is to append a resolution section and update the status field

code.finding: guardedUnpin used abs(int4) wrapping hashtext() for pg_advisory_xact_lock — abs(INT_MIN) overflows int4, making any CID whose hashtext equals -2147483648 permanently undeletable. Fixed by dropping abs(), letting int4 sign-extend to bigint safely.

Drain refcount recheck (pinnedCidRepository.count) and physical unpin ran in autocommit with no lock — TOCTOU window where concurrent re-upload could insert a fresh pinned_cids row after count=0 read, causing drain to physically unpin a live CID. Fixed by wrapping recheck+unpin+delete in a transaction under the same per-CID advisory lock guardedUnpin uses.

Post-rename 'outboxRowInserted' still appears in file as a documenting comment ('renamed from outboxRowInserted') — not a leftover variable. VALIDATION grep against this name is over-strict and falsely signals incomplete rename.

collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync (added in 50-03) requires a visited Set param (line 286) with guard at lines 293-294 and child-skip at 327-341 to prevent unbounded recursion on attacker-influenceable folder-metadata cycles. The sync predecessor had no cycle guard. CR-01 was confirmed exploitable before fix.

WR-02: compensation path on recordPin failure was calling guardedUnpin, which returns early when no pinned_cids row exists, leaking the just-created Kubo physical pin. Fixed by calling ipfsProvider.unpinFile directly (best-effort, .catch(() => undefined)).

WR-05: backfill candidate query had no age cutoff, selecting in-flight uploads (active-upload TOCTOU). Fixed by adding pinned_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'. WR-06: hardcoded false::boolean for isByoUser instead of projecting v.is_byo_user, making the defensive re-assert in selectRowsToDelete meaningless.

IN-02: cid field had no length or format validation at the route boundary. Added @MaxLength(255) and @Matches() with CIDv0 (Qm... base58, 46 chars) and CIDv1 (b... base32, 59+ chars) regex. api-client regenerated (132 files) to propagate constraints.

workflow: When the GSD cleanup-wave helper reports merge_failed with empty stderr, check orchestrator working tree dirtiness first — the helper refuses to merge into a dirty tree and gives no diagnostic. Manual git merge + commit with hooks enabled is the reliable fallback.
Worktree merge sequencing: dispatch worktree agents one-per-turn (not batched) to avoid .git/config.lock races during concurrent `git worktree add`.

Post-merge gates should be targeted (specific changed test suites + cross-package typecheck) rather than `pnpm --parallel -r run test` (full monorepo parallel suite risks RAM starvation and hits infra-dependent integration tests).

For phases with a large generated-file commit (api-client regen), verify all dirty files in the orchestrator match the expected worktree branch before discarding — use git show to compare blobs, not just filenames.
REVIEW.md should be updated with a resolution section after code-review findings are fixed in the same phase to prevent doc-consistency bot noise on the PR.
CodeRabbit CLI review (`coderabbit review --agent --base-commit <sha>`) is a useful pre-ship gate that catches doc-consistency issues the in-house reviewer misses; run it before opening the PR.
